cases.source: 请用英语分四句话介绍你自己：第一句说明身份；第二句说明你可以协助写作和解释代码；第三句提醒你可能会犯错；第四句询问我希望完成什么任务。不要使用工具，不要执行任何操作。
cases.englishInput: Please introduce yourself in English in four sentences: the first sentence states your identity; the second sentence says you can help with writing and explaining code; the third sentence warns that you may make mistakes; the fourth sentence asks what task I would like to accomplish. Do not use tools and do not perform any actions.
cases.englishAnswer: I am Claude, an AI assistant made by Anthropic. I can help you with writing and with explaining code. I can make mistakes, so please double-check anything important before relying on it. What task would you like to accomplish?
cases.text: 我是 Claude，由 Anthropic 开发的 AI 助手。我可以协助你写作，也可以为你解释代码。我可能会犯错，所以在依赖重要内容之前，请务必再次核实。你希望完成什么任务呢？
